story.what_it_does: Hindustan Zinc mines and refines zinc, lead and silver, and also sells by-products such as sulfuric acid and fertiliser inputs. In FY2026 it produced about 1,114 kt of mined metal and 1,048 kt of refined metal, earning revenue of ₹40,844 crore. Silver contributes roughly 45% of profitability.
story.plans: It guides to FY27 mined metal of 1,150 kt and refined metal of 1,100 kt, plus growth capex of $500-600 million. Larger projects include a 250 ktpa zinc smelter expansion (due 2QFY29), a tailings reprocessing plant (4QFY28) and a fertiliser plant. It also targets 70% renewable power by FY28 and a new rare earth mining lease.
story.moat: Management points to very low zinc cost of production, which fell to $703 per tonne in Q2 FY27, and to EBITDA margins of 62%. It also cites large ore reserves of 468.6 million tons and by-product income from silver. Much of the margin strength has come from metal prices and by-products, not only from the company's own advantage.

scenarios.story: Metal prices stay firm, costs stay near the new low levels and the expansion projects finish on time. Production grows toward guidance and the company keeps paying dividends from strong cash flow.
signals_to_watch: Zinc cost of production staying near or below the revised $825-850 FY27 guidance
Progress on the 250 ktpa smelter and tailings plant against 2QFY29 and 4QFY28 dates

scenarios.story: Earnings stay strong but ease as the dollar and metal prices normalise from record levels. Production grows modestly toward 1,150 kt mined and 1,100 kt refined, with capex around ₹5,000 crore.
signals_to_watch: Quarterly mined and refined metal output versus FY27 guidance
Silver production of 149 tons in Q1 versus the 680 ton FY27 target

scenarios.story: A fall in silver or zinc prices, or a weaker dollar, cuts profit sharply since silver is about 45% of profitability. Rising input costs, tax and royalty disputes, or governance issues could add pressure.
signals_to_watch: Silver's share of profitability and any fall in metal prices
Outcomes of the pending tax dispute of ₹12,387 crore and the SEBI and independent director matters
